claims.summary: Over F2 let A:m by n, B:n by m, select k outer indices I with 1<=k<n,m>=k, and let G be all Boolean axioms plus (AB)_I,I=I_k (a consistent partial rank base). Let H contain every degree-(k+1) monomial choosing one selected-row entry in each of k+1 distinct columns. For the prior minor operator Lambda(f)=sum_(|S|=k) det(A_I,S)det(B_S,I) sigma_S(f), T=k+1: Lambda1-1 lies in I_2k(G); f-Lambda f lies in I_(2k+T d)(G+H) for deg f<=d; Lambda(I_q(G+H)) is contained in I_(2k+T q)(G), q>=max(2,k+1), where I_q means bounded ordinary certificates. Hence Lambda is an idempotent unital linear retraction in R/(G), with kernel exactly the ideal of H. Its image with product u*v=Lambda(uv) is R/(G+H), the function algebra where the selected rows use at most k columns. Lambda^2 f-Lambda f has a G-certificate through 2k(1+T)+T^2 d; Lambda(x Lambda f)-Lambda(x f) through that ceiling plus T. These identities do not prove same-cutoff kernel stability modulo C_D of the full inconsistent rank system. On that full system, adding H preserves degree-D propriety when m>n,n-k>=2D-1,D>=2 by a constant identity-frame restriction. This recovered conditioning supplies no arbitrary mixed-source error-rank bound.
